messages.text:
The shop’s records show two napkins received back, but not the third. All three cannot be refunded now: items must be received before they can be refunded. Have you already sent the third napkin? Would you like to request a refund for just the two received? (refund-policy/v2/return)

For identical items, the discounted total is divided equally, rounded down to whole centavos; any leftover centavos are added one at a time to the last items. Those shares stay fixed. Your recorded shares are **BRL 91.00 each**—BRL 273.00 for all three, or BRL 182.00 for two. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

I can’t promise payment today: a proposal needs your button confirmation and staff approval, and the shop gives no date for funds to appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/approval) (refund-policy/v2/payout)
